The question asks for the value and stops there ("What was the birth surname…?"), with no either/or, and the doubt sits in the rationale, per the ruling. test_premise_question_names_fact passed. The rationale is accurate: Hartwell comes from an unsourced FamilySearch tree entry and may be her married name. One genealogy note: "Ohio state vital registrations" won't hold an 1855 birth (county births begin 1867, statewide 1908). Her marriage record, the 1860/1870 censuses, and a post-1908 death certificate are the sources that would name her birth surname.
